about: Which release carried each done backlog row that carries no releasedIn. Derived from CHANGELOG.md and git by scripts/derive-released-in.ts; the rules are src/lib/backlog/releasedInBackfill.ts. Only rows with confidence 'certain' may be written, and only by scripts/backfill-released-in.ts.

mapped.title: Standing game options kept against the account

evidence.quote: Standing game options kept against the account: board, clocks, length, rated and the advanced switches, set once and used to start every new game

mapped.title: Choose how long a finished game stays in your own list

evidence.quote: A member can say how long a finished game stays in their own list: a week, a fortnight, a month, three months, or for ever. The record keeps every game whatever it says

mapped.title: A recurring weekly day off that deadlines honour

evidence.quote: A member can name the days of the week they do not play, and deadlines in games that honour vacation step over them every week without spending an away day

mapped.title: A draw when nobody has won by a share of the board

evidence.quote: Hex ヘックス: a rhombus of hexagons, six neighbours to a cell, and the game is won by joining your own two sides. A draw is impossible, which is a fact about the board rather than a rule.

mapped.heldBackBy: score 0.325 under 0.62; only 0.1 clear of the next release

mapped.title: Hex ヘックス, on a rhombus of hexagons

evidence.quote: Hex ヘックス: a rhombus of hexagons, six neighbours to a cell, and the game is won by joining your own two sides. A draw is impossible, which is a fact about the board rather than a rule.

mapped.title: A plain-text list of every game, not one game at a time

evidence.quote: The whole record can be copied out as plain text: every game these filters select, in aligned columns, from the foot of the record page

mapped.title: A Wikipedia link and a country of origin on rules pages

evidence.quote: Rules pages carry the flag of the country a game came from and a link to its Wikipedia article, so the page can be checked against something outside the site

mapped.title: More on ratings, from the elder sites' own explanations

evidence.quote: The About page tells the numbers: Elo with its formula and curve, the twenty-six renju openings, Connect Four solved, and the elder sites compared.

mapped.title: A clock that starts before anybody has sat down

evidence.quote: The operator's page is three tabs, and a clock starts when the second player sits down

mapped.heldBackBy: score 0.361 under 0.62; only 0.128 clear of the next release

mapped.title: Say how a move is written down, and credit SGF

evidence.quote: Sakata and Tarannikov openings, inspired-by credits, and a second wave of games.

mapped.title: Call the plain game Gomoku, not Freestyle

evidence.quote: The plain game is called Gomoku 五目並べ now, not Freestyle, and the exact-five tournament form is Tournament Gomoku 競技五目: the plain name on the plain game, a qualifier on the tightened one, as GoldToken names them

mapped.title: Grand Reversi 大リバーシ, the flipping game on ten by ten

evidence.quote: Grand Reversi 大リバーシ: the flipping game on a 10×10 board, as ItsYourTurn had it

mapped.title: Ignore a member, and mute an opponent in one game

evidence.quote: Ignore a member: they cannot challenge you and their messages are hidden from you; undo it from your profile. In any shared game, mute just that opponent's messages with one switch.

mapped.title: Halma, a game with no lines in it

evidence.quote: Halma ハルマ: the race game, on 16×16, 10×10 or 8×8, with jump chains and shaded camps; the first game here that is not about lines

mapped.title: Away days that hold a deadline open

evidence.quote: Away days: mark a range on your profile, three days a year, and deadlines in your games wait for it. A game can be set up to ignore vacation days.

mapped.title: A champions page with a ladder for every game

evidence.quote: Champions 名人: the best-rated player at every game on one page, and each game's own ladder beneath it

mapped.title: Every name the site prints leads to that player

evidence.quote: Every member has a page from the day they join, so every name the site prints leads to the person; a test now walks the lists and fails if any name is printed without a link

mapped.title: Every game and variant on one plain page

evidence.quote: Every game on one plain page at /games/all, family by family, with the names the other sites gave each one
